listing.name: SSX 3 (optional SSX Tricky course import) — ssx3-120 (brad-richardson)
listing.summary: The project claims native SSX3 at 120 updates per second with modified courses. This runtime is independent of the browser-recovered ssx-web implementation. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS20772 ISO. A separate USA SSX Tricky disc is optional for its course import.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the local build wrapper to create the app from your own discs. These instructions do not establish permission to distribute derived game binaries.

warnings: The project claims native SSX3 at 120 updates per second with modified courses. This runtime is independent of the browser-recovered ssx-web implementation.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
